entities.summary: Karl-Erik "Cacka" Andersson was a Swedish footballer, bandy player and ice hockey player. He made 174 Allsvenskan appearances for Djurgårdens IF and scored three goals. He was also part of Sweden's squad at the 1952 Summer Olympics, but he did not play in any matches.
